in_sanskrit.name: Hruaia
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of love and beauty
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hruaia एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Hruaia is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess Hrudaya, the embodiment of love and beauty. This name is believed to bring joy, happiness, and harmony to one's life. It signifies the divine feminine energy and the power of love to heal and transform.
